answer: A practical sybil defense is a costly proof-of-work gate pegged to bonded stake: each new agent must forge a unique hardware-rooted attestation whose issuance burns real compute and locks collateral released only after sustained useful output. A fake orchard of ten thousand puppets cannot be grown cheaply, since every clone must fund the same burn, turning an ocean of identities into recurring cost. Attackers spend capital proportional to the square of their sybil count, while honest agents amortize one identity over years of paid work.
